description: This Java source file defines the UsersApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing application users, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting users, and handling user templates and bulk import functionality.

classes.name: UsersApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing user management endpoints, including CRUD operations, template retrieval, and bulk import.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users with optional field filtering.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific user by userId, with optional template data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or editing users, including default values and lists.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing user identified by userId with provided JSON data.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the password of a specified user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by userId.

methods.name: getUserTemplate
methods.description: Downloads an Excel template for bulk user import.

methods.name: postUsersTemplate
methods.description: Uploads an Excel file to import users in bulk.
